en-US.author: Stephan Aßmus
en-US.description: An LLM-powered, autonomous coding assistant with a native GUI, a terminal mode, and MCP and ACP modes.
en-US.longDescription:
An open-source AI coding agent, written in Rust, with a native GUI, a terminal mode, and integrations for editors and MCP clients.
It runs an autonomous agent loop over your codebase — reading, searching, editing files, and running commands — while keeping you in the loop about what it is actually doing. The same binary serves as an MCP server (code-assistant server) and as an ACP agent for editors such as Zed (code-assistant acp).
en-US.name: Code Assistant

zh-CN.description: 基于大语言模型的自主编程助手，提供原生 GUI、终端模式以及 MCP 和 ACP 模式。
zh-CN.longDescription:
一个用 Rust 编写的开源 AI 编程智能体，提供原生 GUI、终端模式，以及面向编辑器和 MCP 客户端的集成。
它在你的代码库上运行自主智能体循环——读取、搜索、编辑文件并运行命令——同时让你随时了解它正在做什么。同一二进制文件还可作为 MCP 服务器（code-assistant server）和面向 Zed 等编辑器的 ACP 智能体（code-assistant acp）使用。
